posts.content_md:
I'm so happy. 30 small plates, 6 large ones, developer and everything. The integraf approach is actually surprisingly simple. How refreshing to see a completely different setup. They really seem to have spend much time to make the kit as easy and foolproof as possible.

Yeah everyone else would prolly have rushed into the bathroom and taken a quick first shot, but being me I am still reading the accompanying booklets and instructions... ^__^

I'm totally in love by the "Experiments you can do" booklet from Tung H. Jeong... Very good reading. Makes me wanna get some holographic film, the cylindrical approach in a jar seems to be tempting.

I will keep the practical experiments probably for tomorrow as I'll be getting guests tonight and still have to do some shopping and cooking. I hope i can soon show my first selfmade hologram in the Gallery. *smiles*
